text:
Marta (CS): quick heads-up — Hearthwell (org: hearthwell-prod) asked for a short Singapore pilot tomorrow. They need an IP allowlist + a temporary throughput bump on the SG edge for 48h. Renewal conversation is tied to this demo, so this is time-sensitive. cc @Arjun (Eng) @Devon (Ops)
Arjun (Eng): what do you need from CS to act? list of IPs, exact qps/rps, and which model/route they plan to hit. also need desired start/end window.
Marta (CS): good call. Rafa from Hearthwell sent the info: IPs are 3.250.112.45 and 3.250.112.46, API key hw-demo-01, target is 200 rps total for the demo, duration 48h starting 2026-04-12T02:00Z. Model: redwood-3.7-aligned (short prompts).
Arjun (Eng): copying the request here, will validate capacity for ap-southeast-1. also need to confirm whether 200rps should be applied as a global policy (org-level) or per-key. what do you recommend, @Leah?
Leah (Support): for demo safety, per-key cap is better (less blast radius). we can set org fallback to current default and add a temporary per-key policy for hw-demo-01 to 200rps. also add IP allowlist for those two CIDRs.
Marta (CS): per-key is fine — they only use the single key during the demo. putting the official ask here for records:
```json
{
  "org": "hearthwell-prod",
  "api_key": "hw-demo-01",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "allowlist_ips": ["3.250.112.45/32", "3.250.112.46/32"],
  "temp_rate_limit": "200rps",
  "duration": "48h",
  "start": "2026-04-12T02:00:00Z",
  "purpose": "sales demo -> renewal decision"
}
```
Arjun (Eng): ok I'm checking node capacity and quota. if we don't have spare capacity in the SG edge we can route to nearest region with lower latency (ap-northeast-1) and set a region override on the route. will confirm in 10–15m.
sre-bot: incident-check: no active incidents impacting ap-southeast-1.
Devon (Ops): reserving a burst slot and preparing the temporary policy. can someone confirm the exact CIDR mask we should apply? Marta?
Marta (CS): confirmed /32s as in the JSON. customer also asked for logging of request IDs during the demo for postmortem metrics. they want token-level cost visibility afterwards.
Arjun (Eng): noted. I'm also going to pin a temporary KV cache bypass for the demo to ensure cold-start behavior is visible — will note in the route. setting rollout: immediate + auto-revert after 48h.
Devon (Ops): applied preliminary config. summary:
- Region: ap-southeast-1 edge routing set (fallback to ap-northeast-1 if capacity constrained)
- Temp per-key rate limit: 200rps for hw-demo-01, duration 48h starting 2026-04-12T02:00Z
- IP allowlist: 3.250.112.45/32, 3.250.112.46/32
- Logging: request-id + token usage enabled and exported to cs-logs/notifications
sre-bot: config-deploy: route-policy-hearthwell-1842109876 created by Devon.
Rafa (Hearthwell): thanks team — confirmed on our side. we'll run the demo window as scheduled and share log access afterwards. really appreciate the fast turnaround, this demo decides our procurement timeline.
Marta (CS): marking renewal as at-risk -> urgent until demo completes. will follow up with account exec and capture feedback after demo. :thumbsup:
Arjun (Eng): all done from infra side; monitoring hooks added. will alert if any throttles occur.
Leah (Support): I'll join the demo window on standby. tagging this thread for post-demo notes and handoff to renewals.
Marta (CS): perfect, closing loop here. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
